title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, an unauthenticated user could trick a user that holds a role with…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, an unauthenticated attacker can craft a malicious link to the User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) Overview dashboard. If a user with the ueba_can_view_ui capability opens this link, attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands may execute with that user's permissions. This can lead to exposure or modification of data accessible to the user and partial disruption of search processing. Exploitation requires phishing the user to open the malicious link. The vulnerability arises because the dashboard does not properly escape filter values before inserting them into SPL searches.
